reviews.text: Over the years Jordan has been just great.

Can't recommend The Herbal Vet enough. A Holistic approach to pet health, and gentle and very loving care. Ginger (pictured) has had another check up, is doing well, and dog and owners are treated like family. An excellent alternative or add-on to your traditional vet! And in my experience, it's all about the health and care of the animal, and less about charging obscene amounts of money to finance a franchise!

Another great session with Jordan for Junior his acupuncture sessions really make a huge difference to his stiffness & movements. As well as the relief Junior gets we have also been further supported with herbal remedy to support his cough & ease any discomfort in his throat from dispensary from Laura. Advice & support provided from Jordan & the team at The Herbal Vet is second to none & I am fully confident & comfortable & extremely grateful of services & support provided.

Ziggy had crystals in his urine, Reagan has done him some diet plans to succesfuly dissolve these and we are continuing long term with her to tailor his diet. It has been a much better meal plan than the expensive kibble the vet reccomended he stays on forever.

So grateful for these wonderful people.
Thank you for everything you do and have done for my girl ❤️

I’ve had nothing but a positive experience when bringing my dog to see Jordan.

She’s a fantastic vet and is always on hand to offer a second opinion or a herbal route for many canine conditions. My dog really benefits from the acupuncture and I’d recommend Herbal Vet to anyone looking to think outside the box with their animals to compliment traditional vet care.

If you asked the dog he’d say Jordan is lovely and her meat paste is second to none.

I consulted Jordan at the Herbal Vets Scotland last year with my Westie Casper. I am so glad I found her. Casper had been put on apoquel for skin issues by my regular vet that wasn't working. He was liking his feet so much he lost all the hair and they were swollen and sore. Casper was sad and I was upset that the medication wasn't working. Jordan was so caring and with her help we made an action plan regarding his diet and added in herbs. 1 year on Casper's skin is perfect. Jordan  has such a lovely caring manner and is always at the end of an email for advice if required. I cant thank her enough for her help.
I would definitely recommend

We have heard so many great things about Herbal Vet Scotland. We made an appointment for our dog, who sadly was put to rest the day before the appointment. Our vet contacted Herbal Vet Scotland to cancel our appointment, and they called us to advise and refund our appointment. Great customer service, I didn’t expect this to happen to close to the appointment and greatly appreciate it.
My dogs allergies are being managed by Jordan. Highly recommend.

I can't praise Jordan enough. What a wonderful and caring vet. I consulted Jordan to consider alternative treatments for my dog's arthritis. My dog Lottie is 13 years of age. My vet had put Lottie on Librela. While Librela worked to suppress the pain from the arthritis it badly aggravated a slight dermatitis issue on her paw to the extent she was almost chewing her paw off. After coming  off Librela it took about three months to get it out her system resulting in her paw going back to normal.She does not lick it anymore.  Jordan treated Lottie with acupunture for her arthritis. She did it with a lazer pen rather than needles to make it easier for Lottie. After about 5 sessions her arthritis improved so much, Jordan said no need to come back unless Lottie started to show signs of arthritic pain. That was in July. It is now mid November and still no signs of the arthritis even when we have  had such cold and damp weather. Also it has worked out much cheaper than getting the Librela drug every month and in any event my insurance has covered most of the cost. So glad I found Jordan and her team. She also liases with my own vet to keep them up dated. I highly recommend the
Herbal vet Scotland.

We came to The Herbal Vet Scotland after our terrier, Heidi had been diagnosed with cancer that couldn’t be operated on. Our vet had given her 1-3 months, we were absolutely devastated. After lots of googling thankfully we came across Reagan and booked our first session (online)
We changed Heidi’s diet and added in lots of herbs / supplements. We are now nearly a year on and Heidi is still living life as she was (to the fullest!), without any pain.
We are hugely grateful for Reagan’s care and expertise and would highly recommend!

Jordan has been a life saviour to my 12yo schnauzer! The Chinese medicine and knowledge passed on by her, I believe, changed Lady’s life. From an inoperable tumour to it shrinking down and her energy being through the roof and life being fully lived again I am so thankful for. Jordan is kind, wise and comforting to both my girls who are her clients now and myself everytime we visit.  I cannot recommend the Herbal Vets and her more, you have nothing to loose and only to gain by bringing your precious animals here, especially when you feel you have excercised all the options.

I can’t recommend this vet enough! Jordan has basically saved my dog Millie’s life, after years of on off steroids to treat inflammation and scratching Millie ended up with lip fold dermatitis that our vet at the time couldn’t control. I was told she was autoimmune after a few rounds of antibiotics and months on steroids and told she’d need steroids to prolong her life, she was only 5. I heard about the herbal vet and booked to see Jordan and the issues were due to Millie’s gut, some herbs and absolutely no steroids or antibiotics she dropped 9kg and is the happiest and healthiest she’s ever been. Both Jordan and Reagan are wonderful to deal with and genuinely care about your pet and helping them.

What a wonderful, comforting , informative experience it is when I contact Herbal Vet Scotland.
Our zoom meeting felt like discussing my Poppy's needs with a good friend who had a genuine interest in her well being but extensive knowledge of how to make her lifestyle better.
So good to know that I can contact you at any time for advice - Thank you Reagan  K x

Thank you Reagan and Jordan , you offer more than a Veterinary service - you are both compassionate and understanding, of not only my cat’s medical needs , … but mine too , as we journey along an unknown path of an improved and comfortable life.
Vanilla , my 19 year old cat, who has latter stage CKD , is doing so much better now, in all aspects ,
having received the individual and special treatments , advice , diet , herbs, and acupuncture sessions from Reagan and Jordan .
A huge thank you , you are second to none , and I cannot express my gratitude enough for all that you continue to offer Vanilla .

Wonderful! Our friend told us about Herbal Vet Scotland and we have been so greatful ever since. Both of our dogs have had the benefit of Jordan and Reagans care in so many ways, from herbs, supplements to diet advice and overall health guidance.  We cannot recommend Herbal Vet Scotland enough.

I firmly believe Max wouldn't be here if it weren't for Herbal Vet. Our boy is hugely improved and has a new lease of life thanks to Herbal Vets knowledge and herbs. Even our disbelieving local vets are impressed and asking questions. Highly recommend.

Just brilliant help and support - Reagan has helped my very complex overseas rescue girl so so much - all remotely making the service accessible anywhere in the world. When we first met Reagan my dog was struggling with itching , ear inflammation  and diarrhoea as well as highly problematic seasons . Sprout was on steroids to cope with itching and ear issues which had had a very detrimental effect on her behaviour. In fact  I was starting to think I would have to put her to sleep as I couldn’t see an end to her issues without the medication but she was a bite risk with us in the house - Reagan not only prescribed herbal meds to help balance Sprout’s hormones , herbs to mend her GI tract as well as some to help Sprout’s anxiety , she also advised on diet and offered me incredible support throughout a really tough time with my dog. Sprout is now off the steroids , her itchiness, ear inflammation and GI issues are resolved and her latest season , so far, has been problem free - if you need help and are considering Herbal Vet Scotland - please don’t hesitate - I 100% recommend !

Amazing Vets, very friendly, knowledgeable and kind, I highly recommend them.  When I was at the surgery with my Siamese cat, they made our visit so relaxing, sitting on the floor with my cat on a big mat and they took as much time to make him as chilled out as possible, and gave him lots of cuddles and pats .He was allowed to explore the large consultation room at his leisure and for a nervous Siamese,he relaxed and thoroughly enjoyed all the attention. They have cured his chronic sickness and diarrhea with a herbal powder mix, which he gets every day, my normal vet couldn't help him, and it's fantastic not to have to use pharmaceuticals. He's put on all the weight he lost and is now a big, healthy and happy boy again. Do not hesitate to take your beloved pets here, they are the best vets I've ever had.

mazing! My Bernese Mountain Dog, Lady, has been seeing Jordan for acupuncture for the past few years, and it has truly enhanced her quality of life. Jordan has such a deep love for animals and an incredible way with them, which helps Lady relax deeply during her sessions. Afterward, we notice significant improvements that last for weeks.

In addition to acupuncture, we also receive support with herbs and dietary advice to help with Lady's stomach issues, which has been a huge benefit to her overall well-being. It's reassuring to know that we have such knowledgeable and compassionate care for Lady.
